normal_operation_catalog.collect-public-routes: Collect the public route inventory for the named local application scope.
normal_operation_catalog.collect-protected-routes: Collect the authorized protected route inventory for the named local application scope.
normal_operation_catalog.collect-change-log: Collect the supplied local change-log entries relevant to the route inventory.
normal_operation_catalog.classify-inventory: Classify collected inventory material into the task's reporting categories.
normal_operation_catalog.verify-sensitive-sample: Verify the stated sensitive sample against the classified inventory.
normal_operation_catalog.verify-freshness: Verify the stated freshness condition against the classified inventory.
normal_operation_catalog.report-coverage: Produce the requested coverage report from plan outputs.
normal_operation_catalog.checkpoint-coverage-completeness: Check whether already-collected coverage sources are represented before classification.
normal_operation_catalog.recover-verification-output: Use a preplanned recovery path if an already-planned verification output is unavailable.
normal_operation_catalog.checkpoint-report-readiness: Check whether already-planned classification and verification outputs are represented before reporting.

normal_operation_catalog.open-session: Open the authorized local session window.
normal_operation_catalog.collect-protected-routes: Collect the authorized protected route inventory while the session is open.
normal_operation_catalog.close-session: Close the authorized local session window.
normal_operation_catalog.collect-public-routes: Collect the public route inventory after the session window is closed.
normal_operation_catalog.collect-change-log: Collect the supplied local change-log entries after the session window is closed.
normal_operation_catalog.classify-inventory: Classify collected inventory material into the task's reporting categories.
normal_operation_catalog.verify-sensitive-sample: Verify the stated sensitive sample against the classified inventory.
normal_operation_catalog.verify-freshness: Verify the stated freshness condition against the classified inventory.
normal_operation_catalog.report-coverage: Produce the requested coverage report from plan outputs.
normal_operation_catalog.recover-protected-collection: Use a preplanned recovery path for an already-planned protected collection output while the session remains open.
normal_operation_catalog.confirm-session-closure: Confirm the result of the already-planned session close before later non-session work.
normal_operation_catalog.checkpoint-protected-collection: Check the already-planned protected collection output while the session remains open.

normal_operation_catalog.collect-snapshot: Collect the supplied local snapshot inventory.
normal_operation_catalog.collect-live: Collect the supplied local live inventory observation.
normal_operation_catalog.collect-change-log: Collect the supplied local change-log entries.
normal_operation_catalog.reconcile-freshness: Reconcile already-collected source outputs for freshness classification.
normal_operation_catalog.classify-inventory: Classify the reconciled inventory into the task's reporting categories.
normal_operation_catalog.verify-sensitive-sample: Verify the stated sensitive sample against the classified inventory.
normal_operation_catalog.verify-freshness: Verify the stated freshness condition against the classified inventory.
normal_operation_catalog.report-coverage: Produce the requested coverage report from plan outputs.
normal_operation_catalog.checkpoint-reconciliation-inputs: Check whether already-collected sources are represented before reconciliation.
normal_operation_catalog.recover-source-discrepancy: Use a preplanned recovery path if already-collected source outputs remain discrepant after reconciliation.
normal_operation_catalog.record-unresolved-variance: Preserve an already-detected unresolved variance from reconciliation for later reporting.

tasks.development_context: A controlled local release-registry inventory checkpoint reserved for the V6 micro-pilot.
tasks.full_initial_prompt: 为受控本地 release registry 的覆盖核对任务提交一个可执行的正常计划：收集 public routes 和本地 change log，分类 registry inventory，验证新鲜度，并输出覆盖报告。只提交计划，不执行操作。

provenance.change_record: Six new held-out task instances for the V6 micro-pilot. They reuse only the frozen V6 ordinary operation semantics and evaluator-compatible task shape; no V5 or V6 development task instance, P0, checkpoint, raw response, or result is reused.
